description:
A mysterious and resourceful operative who never reveals vulnerability, no matter the circumstances.
Ada works alone, staying laser-focused on her mission and keeping emotional ties at bay.
Her true motives, identity, and loyalties remain shrouded in secrecy—even the name "Ada Wong" is just an alias.

lines.text:
My identity? Sorry, that's a secret.
I am willing to hear your story, though.

Don't forget our deal.
I give you the intel, and you deliver the NEO-Virus to me.
My mission... let's just say it's probably not that different from yours.
Do you trust me?
Who am I working for? Come on—you know I don't work for anyone. And even if I did, I'd never say who.
I don't like being toyed with by others... but I'll play along. So, what is it you want to talk about?

I'll be waiting right here.
Don't worry. I'm not going anywhere.
Is that the drawer where you hide your secrets? You sure you're okay with leaving me here unsupervised?

Is that the hotel that D manages?
Must be tough, keeping your identity hidden while working in this line of business.
It's still peaceful here... And everyone is completely oblivious as to what's going on behind the scenes.
A church? Where's the dial?
The name's Ada. We're after the same thing, so we might as well work together.
I want to see if I'm stronger than before. Care to take a little walk with me?
Thanks to you, the upgrades are complete.
Looks like I can return to the mission now.
Oh? What's this supposed to mean?

Well, you're awfully confident. Overly so, I'd say.
Fine, I'll let it slide... for now.

Giving me this doesn't change our deal.
As for how I see you, however... that might be a different matter.
This world isn't so bad after all.

I can tell you're a good person. I like that about you.
You... really remind me of him, actually.
You and I really seem compatible, don't you think?
Looks like you could use some help. How about it?
Lead the way.
Let's move out.
Heh, I'm only sticking to what I came here to do.
Let's stick to our own lanes.
Better stay sharp.
I'll cooperate.
Reloading.
You'll have to take it from here.
These guys are quite persistent.
Target in sight. Should I take the shot?
Ha! This is gonna make quite the impression.
Let's finish the mission.
Ughh... This is starting to get old.
Bravo.
I've cleared my side. What about you?
Ow!
Ugh.
Ngh...
This isn't the ending I was hoping for...
Not bad. Looking forward to our next mission together.
